'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals Chris Herr DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Herr]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Chris Herr
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
